how_to: Every prompt in prompt_manifest.json is a template rendered from this file by production/image_prompts.py (build, lint, md, review). Change shared text here, never in a rendered prompt. Workflow: .claude/skills/consistent-image-prompts/SKILL.md; rules: docs/creation-rules.md.

milo.name: Milo
milo.identity: Milo is one slender young wool-felt mouse who walks upright on two legs. His body felt is warm taupe-brown (#8D624F, lighter on the crown #DBB09C) with looped bouclé texture and a soft halo of loose fibres on every outline. His round head is slightly wider at the cheeks, with a smooth felt crown and a fine dashed rust stitched seam from crown to nose. Two very large oval ears, each nearly as tall as the head is wide and tilted slightly outward, rise far above the crown: coral inner felt (#EF775F) inside a thick taupe-brown rim (#8F614E) with a rust stitched seam. Two short dark brown felt brows (#643426). Two large round glossy eyes, each about a fifth of the head width, centres under half a head width apart: dark brown irises (#723725), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4ECE8). A small rounded dark brown nose (#683629) under a soft peach bridge (#F9AC8C); two compact cream muzzle pads (#EFC5AD) with tiny brown dots; a wide mouth line; five long fine peach whiskers (#EEAE85) on each side. A narrow neck, slim torso and an elongated egg-shaped cream belly (#F8CEB4) with a centre seam, ending above the crotch, with a taupe-brown gap between two slim separated legs. Two slim arms with small curled paws; three rounded toes per foot. One long thin salmon tail (#BC735D), about half his height, attached at the lower back. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them, and the felt stays warm. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
milo.sheet: a slender upright taupe-brown felt mouse with a smooth crown, huge coral-lined oval ears, two brown eyes, a small brown nose, cream muzzle and belly, slim limbs and one thin salmon tail
milo.short: Milo is a slender upright taupe-brown felt mouse with a smooth crown, huge coral-lined oval ears, two brown eyes, a small brown nose, cream muzzle and belly, slim limbs and one thin salmon tail, peach whiskers on both sides.
checklist: Exactly one mouse, upright on two slim legs; two arms with small curled paws; two feet with three rounded toes each; one tail attached at the lower back.
Body felt warm taupe-brown (#8D624F, hue ~50 deg, chroma ~23): never neutral or bluish; crown lighter, legs darker.
Smooth crown with only the fibre halo: no hair tuft, forelock or hairstyle.
Two very large oval ears, each nearly as tall as the head is wide, tilted slightly outward, tops far above the crown.
Ear interior bright coral (#EF775F), not dusty rose or pale pink; thick taupe-brown rim with a rust stitched seam.
Head round, slightly wider at the cheeks but compact: at equal ear spacing the cheeks stay inside the ears' inner edges; not jowly or pear-shaped.
Exactly two short dark brown brows.
Two large round eyes ~1/5 head width, dark brown irises, black pupils, one white catch-light upper right, ivory sclera.
Small rounded dark brown nose (~0.18 head width) under a soft peach bridge; not triangular, not enlarged.
Compact cream muzzle with tiny brown dots; closed wide smile; rounded cream chin.
Five long fine peach whiskers visible on BOTH sides.
Dashed rust seam from crown to nose, low contrast.
Narrow neck, slim torso; elongated egg-shaped cream belly with centre seam ending above the crotch; taupe-brown gap between the legs, no cream bridge.
Tail thin, smooth, salmon, about half his height, single, tapering.
Looped bouclé felt texture with loose-fibre halo on all outlines; no blotches or missing arm seams.
milo.mouth: When Milo's mouth opens, it is a small rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior, a soft pink tongue and no visible teeth; only when he gnaws do his two small rounded ivory-cream upper incisors show.

leo.name: Leo
leo.identity: Leo is one young, compact, sturdy wool-felt lion who walks on four legs. His body felt is warm ochre-orange (#DE7F35), lighter on the forehead (#F99A4A), with fine looped bouclé fibres and thin dashed golden stitching down the centre of the forehead and the front of each front leg. A huge round rust-red mane (#BE3006; lit lock tips vermilion #E14512, inner locks deep rust #A62503) of long tapered teardrop locks surrounds the face; it is about twice the face width and three quarters of his standing height across, and hangs into a pointed bib over a cream chest. The face is a broad rounded disc. Two round ochre ears with a lighter apricot rim and salmon inner felt (#CF7E64), each 0.4 of the face width, sit at its upper corners. Two thick dark brown felt brows (#7A2F15). Two large round glossy eyes, each one fifth of the face width, centres half a face width apart: russet-brown irises (#772E13), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F3E4DA). A rounded peach nose pad (#F9905E) above a wide, rounded inverted-triangle dark brown nose (#693120). Two puffed cream muzzle pads (#F7D4BB) with four brown dots each, a gentle mouth line, a large rounded cream chin, and five fine pale cream whiskers on each side. Four large rounded light tan paws (#EDA36C) with four toes each. One ochre tail ending in a rust-red tuft. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them, and the felt stays warm and saturated. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
leo.sheet: a sturdy ochre-orange felt lion with a huge round rust-red mane, cream muzzle and chest, two brown eyes, a peach nose pad over a dark brown nose, four tan paws and one tail with a rust-red tuft
leo.short: Leo is a sturdy ochre-orange felt lion with a huge round rust-red mane, cream muzzle and chest, two brown eyes, a peach nose pad over a dark brown nose, four tan paws and one tail with a rust-red tuft, pale cream whiskers on both sides.

checklist: Exactly one lion; four legs, four large rounded paws with four toes each; one tail with one rust-red tuft.
Body felt warm ochre-orange (#DE7F35), saturated; not yellow, not beige, not desaturated.
Mane rust-red with vermilion lit tips (hue ~44 deg LCh); not crimson/cherry (bluish red), not brown-maroon, not orange-yellow.
Mane volume: about 2x face width and ~3/4 of standing height across; full circle plus pointed chest bib; never thin or short.
Mane locks: long tapered teardrop felt locks radiating outward, bright tips; not thick ribbed yarn cords.
Face: broad rounded disc, slightly wider than tall; one dashed golden seam from crown to nose pad, low contrast.
Two round ochre ears with lighter apricot rim and salmon interior at the upper corners of the face, ~0.4 face width.
Exactly two thick dark brown brows.
Two large round eyes ~1/5 face width, russet-brown irises, black pupils, one white catch-light upper right, ivory sclera.
Nose: rounded peach pad on the bridge above a wide rounded inverted-triangle dark brown nose with two nostrils (~0.3 face width).
Two puffed cream muzzle pads with ~4 dark dots each; large rounded cream chin; closed gentle smile; no fangs ever.
About five fine pale cream whiskers visible on BOTH sides.
Cream chest shield visible under the mane bib.
Paws lighter tan than the legs.
Face felt texture is looped bouclé curls, not knitted chevrons; no stray flecks or blotches.
leo.mouth: When Leo's mouth opens, it is a rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and a soft pink tongue; only a smooth gum line shows, with no teeth visible.

blocks.style: Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable.
blocks.runtime_style: Handcrafted matte wool-felt stop-motion miniature, tactile fibres and stitching, softly lit, sharp readable subjects.
blocks.light_and_colour: Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it.
blocks.cast_scale: Relative size (fixed for the whole story): Milo standing is 0.55 of the height of Leo's mane, and Milo's head with ears is about 0.4 of the height of Leo's face; the measured sizes for this camera setup are stated below. Lying down, crouching or sitting changes a silhouette but never the size of a head, mane, body or limb.
blocks.final_check: Before finishing, check: each visible character appears exactly once, with exactly two eyes and two eyebrows (one above each eye, drawn once), its canonical ears and limbs, whiskers on both sides of the muzzle and exactly one tail attached at its root; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere.
blocks.edit_end_frame: This is an edit of the accepted start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position exactly; change only what this frame shows below.
blocks.edit_reference: Edit the first attached reference, the approved parent image: keep the character's identity, colours, brightness and proportions exactly; change only the view or pose stated here.
blocks.edit_expression: Edit the first attached reference, the approved closed-mouth portrait: keep its crop, head size and position, every feature, colour, the felt texture, the whiskers, the backdrop and the light exactly; change only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth.
blocks.studio_full_body: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side.
blocks.studio_portrait: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, with no room, furniture, floor or horizon, and soft even neutral light; head-and-shoulders crop with the whole head, both ears and any mane inside the frame with a small margin; the head keeps the size and eye-line of the approved closed-mouth portrait.
blocks.plate_rules: Empty plate: no characters and no story props. Normal-height camera, the whole scene edge to edge, open in-focus ground where characters will stand, distant background slightly soft. Every landmark keeps the position stated above; a different light state of this place reuses exactly the same geometry.
blocks.net_object: One cream braided-rope net with large square gaps and chunky round knots, every strand the same thickness.
blocks.net_world: World state of the net: exactly one cream braided-rope net exists, with large square gaps, chunky round knots and the same strand thickness in every state. Strand R01 is the near-left closure strand of a folded opening, held between two persistent knots K-left and K-right; cutting R01 opens that closure and every other strand stays. R01, K-left and K-right are names in this record only, never visible writing. One leaf-hidden ground trigger stays at its pressed place after release, even when hidden. The net's state, its knots and the leaf and rope layering carry over across camera cuts; any net or trigger outside the crop stays where it was.
blocks.net_overhead_empty: The overhead branch is empty; the only net is the one below, in the state stated here.
blocks.net_no_reversal: Once frayed or severed, R01 stays damaged; its loose ends stay attached to their original knots.
blocks.acorn_object: The story acorn: one small felt acorn with a warm-brown oval nut and one darker brown textured cap, always the same size and cap-to-nut proportion.
blocks.acorn_world: World state of the acorn: exactly one story acorn exists in the whole story. The story acorn: one small felt acorn with a warm-brown oval nut and one darker brown textured cap, always the same size and cap-to-nut proportion. Its holder or ground contact is the one stated here. The flat feeding stone by the stream keeps its place in the plate. No other acorns, ropes or nets are in this place.
blocks.acorn_offscreen: The single story acorn stays at the stream feeding stone, outside this location; no acorn is visible here.

reference_roles.edit_base: the edit base ({what}): keep everything in it (camera, crop, background, light, every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position) except what this prompt changes
reference_roles.identity_root: {who}'s approved canonical image: copy {who}'s identity exactly, with the same shapes, proportions, colours and brightness
reference_roles.locked_plate: the locked location plate ({what}): reproduce this background exactly, with the same landmarks, light and camera
reference_roles.world_state: the previous accepted frame ({what}): carry over the world state (props, damage, contacts and positions) unless this prompt changes it; use the framing stated in this prompt
reference_roles.camera_geometry: camera and layout reference ({what}): copy only the camera position and the layout of the place; take no character or prop state from it
reference_roles.expression: expression reference ({what}): copy only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth shape onto {who}'s canonical face
reference_roles.pose: pose reference ({what}): copy only {who}'s body pose and proportions, not the background
reference_roles.prop: prop reference ({what}): copy the prop's material, colour, shape and size; its state in this frame is the one stated in this prompt
reference_roles.mouth_design: mouth design reference ({what}): copy only the mouth opening, the teeth and their size
reference_roles.staging_only: older-version staging reference ({what}): copy only the composition, camera and staging; every character's look comes from the canonical images
reference_roles.size_anchor: size anchor ({what}): an approved frame of this same camera setup; every character keeps exactly the size it has there, and takes no pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.framing: framing reference ({what}): copy only the shot size, where the head sits in the frame and how strongly the background is blurred; take no character, background, light or expression from it
reference_roles.size_lineup: the story's size lineup ({what}): copy only the size relation between Leo and Milo, applied at the sizes stated in this prompt; take no camera, background, pose, expression or prop state from it
